name: smart-internship-management-system
description: Smart Internship Management System - Full-stack monorepo for managing students, companies, mentors, and administrators.

scripts.clean:ports: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5001, 5173 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
